lines: // A consumed sweep of an active run, also when it returned no new values.
.decl dated_sweep(run: symbol, sweep: symbol, event_time: number)
// The current sweep of a run is its latest dated sweep. A sweep of another run never counts.
.decl current_sweep(run: symbol, sweep: symbol, event_time: number)
current_sweep(run, sweep, time) :- latest_sweep(run, time), dated_sweep(run, sweep, time).
// Only an explicitly complete current sweep can close the round; false and a missing flag cannot.
current_sweep(run, sweep, _), sweep_flag(sweep, complete), complete = TRUE.
// The boundary of a deadline whose start observation belongs to the same run.
.decl deadline_until(run: symbol, step: symbol, deadline: symbol, start: symbol, until: number)
// A deadline must count from a start observation of its own run; another run's start cannot date it.
// A step met its deadline when it is done and its completion value was observed at or before the boundary.
.decl done_in_time(run: symbol, step: symbol, deadline: symbol)
deadline_until(run, step, deadline, _, until), done(run, step, _),
observed(run, token, time, _, "known", value, _), time <= until.
// At the inclusive boundary of its budget a step that did not finish in time has expired.
// The current sweep only dates the round, so an incomplete sweep expires a deadline too.
// Expiry is terminal: a completion observed after the boundary does not clear it.
.decl deadline_expired(run: symbol, step: symbol, sweep: symbol, deadline: symbol, start: symbol)
